style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

A faction leader is the leader of a ⟦0⟧. The default faction leaders in-game are the ⟦1⟧ leading the ⟦2⟧, the ⟦3⟧ leading the ⟦4⟧, the ⟦5⟧ leading the ⟦6⟧ and the ⟦7⟧ leading the ⟦8⟧. They are usually joined by ⟦9⟧ leading the ⟦10⟧ and ⟦11⟧ leading the ⟦12⟧.
If the faction leader ceases to exist, the largest remaining member takes over.
The faction leader may kick another country out even while at war or disband the faction altogether if it contains no other members than themselves and their subjects.

To be able to take over the faction they are in, a country must fulfill the conditions set out by the Rules of the faction. If no "Leadership change" rules are enacted, any nation can take over leadership at any point.
After paying 200 ⟦0⟧, the country can become faction leader, with all the benefits it entails.
No other country can claim leadership for 180 days after this has happened

Every member of a faction has their own pool of ⟦0⟧ and can spend them however they want. Members generate ⟦1⟧ in two ways: passively from manifesto fulfillment and actively by achieving faction goals.
Passive generation is spread amongst members based on their influence.
⟦0⟧ can be spent in various ways to change or buff the faction.
Every faction has a Manifesto; basically a grand design they are trying to achieve.
Every manifesto grants a scaling benefit to faction members, depending on fulfillment, as well as an additional set of bonuses if fulfillment is at least 75%.
